title: Pentaho Live transformation test (pentaho-live-test/1)
description: A regression test with golden datasets for a PDI 9.4 transformation: input steps replaced by fixed datasets, output steps compared row by row with golden CSV files. Paths are relative to the folder of the .test.json file. The 'case', 'test_databases', 'database_safety', 'tables', 'golden_csv' and 'compare' blocks use the same format as the grader's exercise packs.

name.description: Defaults to the file name without .test.json

job.description: 0.7.1: the .kjb tested, relative to the test file, instead of transformation. The whole job runs like Kitchen in the test JVM; outputs, datasets and step tweaks name the Transformation entry (job_entry) whose steps they use

environment.description: The separate JVM the test runs in

locale.description: es_ES, en_US... (numbers and dates of steps that do not declare their format)

max_rows.description: Per captured output and per dataset

user_kettle_home.description: 0.7.1: copy the user's shared.xml connections and kettle.properties variables into the test JVM's temporary KETTLE_HOME (never into the project); false = empty KETTLE_HOME

datasets.description: Steps whose output is replaced by fixed rows (the step does not run; its incoming hops are removed)

job_entry.description: Job tests (0.7.1): the Transformation entry of the job (or the name of its .ktr) where the step is

file.description: CSV: comma, double quotes, header, UTF-8. Unformatted values: plain numbers with '.', dates yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS, booleans Y/N, binaries in base64; empty = null

columns.description: Fields injected, with the metadata they had in the original step. Without columns, every CSV column is a String

format.description: Conversion mask kept on the field (not used to read the CSV)

case.description: A case in the grader pack format. expected = folder of the golden CSV files (<step>.csv, <table>.csv)

db_scripts.description: Connection -> SQL scripts with this test's source data, run after the test database's scripts

executions.description: Runs before capturing, without recreating the databases (2 catches a load that duplicates rows)

test_databases.description: Disposable databases (grader pack format 2): dropped, created and filled with their scripts before the test; the transformation's connections are pointed there by name, database or type and host

password_variable.description: Kettle or environment variable with the password. Never the password itself

outputs.description: Steps whose output rows are compared with a golden CSV

job_entry.description: Job tests (0.7.1): the Transformation entry of the job (or the name of its .ktr) where the step is

file.description: Golden CSV inside case.expected. Default: the step name in lower case with _ (Totales por producto -> totales_por_producto.csv)

compare.description: The grader's comparison options. Defaults for tests: numeric_tolerance 0.000001, extra_columns penalize, max_examples 20

ignore_columns.description: Not compared (load dates, UUIDs, system time)

tables.description: Tables read from the test databases after the run and compared with <case.expected>/<name>.csv (the whole transformation runs)

files.description: 0.7.1: files the run leaves, read as CSV and compared with case.expected/<file>. A file the run did not write (missing or unchanged) fails the test

path.description: May use run variables (${Internal.Entry.Current.Directory}, ${PENTAHO_LIVE_TEST_DIR}); relative = to the test folder

file.description: Golden CSV inside case.expected. Default: file_<file name in lower case with _>.csv

compare.description: The grader's comparison options. Defaults for tests: numeric_tolerance 0.000001, extra_columns penalize, max_examples 20

ignore_columns.description: Not compared (load dates, UUIDs, system time)

tweaks.description: Changes applied to the copy that runs, never to the file

type.description: skip_step: the step does nothing and its rows pass through (a Table output that does not write). remove_step: the step and its hops are removed (if it receives error rows, they end there). set_variable / set_parameter: a value for the run. skip_entry (job tests): the job entry does nothing and the job goes on by its success hop

job_entry.description: Job tests: the entry (skip_entry) or the Transformation entry of the step (skip_step, remove_step)

run_whole_transformation.description: false: only what leads to the captured outputs runs, like a preview
